newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish August s/a trade surplus 538.7 million punts.
newsitem.headline: Irish August s/a trade surplus 538.7 million punts.

text.p: Ireland's seasonally adjusted trade surplus narrowed to 538.7 million punts in August from 727.6 million in July, provisional Central Statistics Office figures showed on Wednesday.
Summary estimates released last month showed imports at 1,490 million and exports at 1,930 million punts, giving a trade surplus of 440 million.
The CSO said summary estimates for September showed imports at 1,760 million punts and exports are estimated at 2,530 million punts, giving a trade surplus of 770 million.
